Review:
First of all, this isn't a health food. This is a treat that we buy for the kids and something that we buy from Amazon's Subscribe and Save program.
The product is great. Compared to all the other fruit snacks out there, these pack a flavorful punch and contain no artificial flavors, synthetic colors or preservatives. They are made with pectin, which comes from fruit (instead of gelatin) and so my four year old--who sometimes worries about eating animals and goes veggie for a week or two, can always have her treat. We buy a lot of Annie's products, and this is easily one of my faves! Thumbs up from this mom.
And a quick note: this product has been on our shopping list for two years with no price change or reduction in count or quality. Kinda rare these days, and I appreciate the consistency.
I'm not paid for my review, my opinions are my own and reflect my family's experience.
